requirements.small_net: Fishing 1 and a small fishing net at a qualifying selected spot.
requirements.fly: Fishing 20, a fly fishing rod, and feathers at a qualifying selected spot.
requirements.karambwan: Fishing 65, the partial Tai Bwo Wannai Trio karambwan-catching progression, a karambwan vessel, and raw karambwanji at a qualifying selected spot.

mechanics.travel: Location and transport are selected and observed by the player; neither a fairy ring nor a fish barrel is a hard requirement.
mechanics.outputs: Catch items, bait loss, XP, spot movement, inventory capacity, and banking results are variable session outputs.

requirements.willow: Woodcutting 30, a usable axe, and an accessible selected willow tree.
requirements.yew: Woodcutting 60, a usable axe, and an accessible selected yew tree.
requirements.redwood_guild: Visible Woodcutting 90, a usable axe, and observed Woodcutting Guild access.

mechanics.attention: These are player-present low-attention options, not unattended or true-AFK claims. Normal and oak chopping are intentionally not normalized as low-attention methods.
mechanics.outputs: Successful chops, log quantities, XP, bird nests, Forestry events, inventory handling, and session duration are variable or player-observed.
